description: Artificial Intelligence: Kerala budget backs AI, elderly care and a new anti-ragging law while proposing skill schemes, Knowledge Valley and support for private buses amid financial strain and limited tax changes in the state.
body_lead: Kerala budget bets on AI, elderly care and anti-ragging Act Targeting the youth, the budget also announced schemes like Global watch tower to identify the global changes in employment and skill sector and equip the youth to tap the potential. Credit: Special Arrangement
